title: Danial Latifi v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Danial Latifi v. Union of India, (2001) 7 SCC 740
content.facts: The Supreme Court considered a dispute requiring interpretation of the governing family-law provision or closely connected statutory rule.
questionsBeforeCourt: What is the correct legal interpretation and application of the governing statutory rule?
content.ratioDecidendi: The husband's obligation to make a reasonable and fair provision is not confined to maintenance for the iddat period; the provision is to be made within the iddat period and can address future sustenance.
content.holding: The husband's obligation to make a reasonable and fair provision is not confined to maintenance for the iddat period; the provision is to be made within the iddat period and can address future sustenance.
content.relevance: Use this authority for the stated statutory proposition, while matching the case facts and the current statutory text before relying on it.
